text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks A, B, and E just because they showed gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each decision by what makes sense from today onward.","I should not treat each stock as a separate account or let its average cost dictate my choices. I need to assess the whole portfolio and avoid holding a position just to avoid admitting a loss.","A few months of price changes do not reliably predict what comes next. I should make deliberate decisions based on my goals and current information, rather than reacting to short-term moves or relying on past prices."]}
